integrity: Each mathematical assertion is backed by an explicit natural Mayer-Vietoris proof and separately computed finite graph-distance and chain calculations. No external validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Only existing finite projective planes, unweighted recomputed shortest-path metrics and fault sets of at most q incidences. Representative mod-two checks do not replace the unrestricted integral proof. Literature equivalence beyond inspected texts remains possible.
title: Sharp arbitrary-incidence-fault stability of projective-plane Rips complexes
